questions.quot: Which data structure follows the LIFO (Last In, First Out) rule?
questions.explanation: In a stack the last element pushed is the first one popped, like a pile of plates.

questions.quot: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n items?
questions.explanation: Binary search halves the search range every step, so it needs about log n steps.

questions.quot: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML is the standard markup language used to structure web pages.

questions.quot: Which of these is NOT a pillar of object-oriented programming?
questions.explanation: The four pillars are encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction.

questions.quot: Which SQL command is used to read data from a table?
questions.explanation: SELECT retrieves rows from one or more tables.

questions.quot: Which symbol starts a single-line comment in C++ and Java?
questions.explanation: // comments out the rest of the line in C, C++, Java and JavaScript.

questions.quot: What is the binary representation of decimal 10?
questions.explanation: 10 = 8 + 2, so the bits are 1010.

questions.quot: Which of these is a version control system?
questions.explanation: Git tracks changes in source code and lets teams work together.

questions.quot: What does API stand for?
questions.explanation: An API defines how one piece of software can talk to another.

questions.quot: Which sorting algorithm uses the divide and conquer approach with O(n log n) in all cases?
questions.explanation: Merge sort splits the array, sorts each half and merges them, always in O(n log n).

questions.quot: Which of these is a relational database?
questions.explanation: MySQL stores data in tables with rows and columns and uses SQL.

questions.quot: Which of these memories is the fastest?
questions.explanation: Cache sits closest to the CPU and is faster than RAM, SSD or hard disk.

questions.quot: Which protocol is used to browse websites securely?
questions.explanation: HTTPS encrypts the connection using TLS.

questions.quot: What is the result of 5 % 2 in most programming languages?
questions.explanation: % gives the remainder: 5 divided by 2 leaves 1.

questions.quot: Which data structure follows the FIFO (First In, First Out) rule?
questions.explanation: In a queue the first element added is the first one removed.

questions.quot: In programming, what is a bug?
questions.explanation: A bug is a mistake that makes a program behave in an unexpected way.

questions.quot: Which keyword exits a loop immediately in C, C++, Java and Python?
questions.explanation: break ends the nearest enclosing loop right away.

questions.quot: What does CSS stand for?
questions.explanation: CSS controls how HTML elements look: colors, spacing, layout and fonts.

questions.quot: Which of these is a NoSQL database?
questions.explanation: MongoDB stores data as flexible JSON-like documents instead of tables.

questions.quot: What does a compiler do?
questions.optionOne: Runs the code line by line
questions.optionFour: Translates the whole source code into machine code before running
questions.correctAns: Translates the whole source code into machine code before running
questions.explanation: A compiler converts the complete program to machine code; an interpreter runs it line by line.
